name: punicalagin
summary: High-molecular-weight ellagitannin from pomegranate peel and juice with potent antioxidant activity and gut microbiome-modulating effects. Converted to urolithins by gut bacteria; solid human evidence base.
description: Punicalagin, a pomegranate ellagitannin, is supported by strong polyphenol bioactivity, with plausible effects on inflammation, antioxidant defenses, and vascular function.
safetyNotes: Mostly preclinical or source-extract evidence. Isolated-compound safety is not equivalent to food/herb exposure; use caution with pregnancy, liver/kidney disease, and polypharmacy.
evidenceLevel: Editorial grade not demonstrated by recorded studies
